The CloudWatch log group for a Lambda function is created automatically only when all three of the following conditions hold. First, the Lambda execution role must have the `logs:CreateLogGroup` permission. Second, the execution role must also have the `logs:PutLogEvents` permission. Third, the function must complete at least one successful invocation. The invocation must happen before the log group can be created, so the log group does not exist until that first successful run has occurred.

If any of these conditions is missing, the function appears to run successfully, but no logs are written. No error is surfaced in this case, so the absence of logs is easy to overlook.
